newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates close virtually unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates close virtually unchanged.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates hovered slightly below the one-week reverse repo rate of 21.75 percent on Wednesday and could drop next week, dealers said.
Overnight rates closed at 21.625 to 21.75 percent, virtually unchanged from Tuesday.
"I could imagine a very slight decrease but...for this week, I expect the rates to remain about these levels," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank.
"The majority of banks are liquid with much higher supply than demand," he said, adding that rates should drop next week.
Banks still have the choice of placing their funds in one-week repo deals but do not want to place money over the end of the reserve period.
The overnight rates have declined gradually from 26.50 percent on January 2 and may only find support at 20 percent by the end of the banks' current reserve period next week, dealers said.
